title: Mineplay
body:
# Welcome to Mineplay!

This is Mineplay, a server that crossplays Minecraft (Java and Bedrock) with Roblox! (and vice versa!)

> If you wanna join the Roblox side, you can join the game [Mineplay](https://www.roblox.com/games/16333718768/Mineplay-Crossplay) on Roblox!
## Read me
> This server is not owned by myself and instead other people better than me, but I wanna make the server popular with this.

### uhhh....
> This server might have some data packs and stuff but I don't own it, I do know it uses Bare Bones.

>  Do not worry, I will NOT collect any revenue from this project, I don't wanna get free money, I just wanna promote this server for free, all for the Mineplay devs.
